title: There’s a life that’s deeper than our mind
first_line: There’s a life that’s deeper than our mind,

lines: There’s a life that’s deeper than our mind,
With experience of man, yet so divine.
It’s a life that knows no bounds;
It’s of depth and height and breadth
Now this life is just the living One
Manifested in the Person of the Son.
Growing up to be the church
O Lord, we’re just for Your flowing;
How we need a deeper knowing!
And why You’ve come in us.
Turn us, Lord, turn us now;
In the church, we all can apprehend
All the riches of this life that is within.
But a deep and peaceful life
Is just waiting to flow out, a living spring.
With the saints it’s easy to be bold,
To pursue this life, to gain it, to lay hold.
All the other things we find,
So that only life remains for us to see.
Deeper, Lord our turn must be to You;
We would move by life in everything we do;
Grant us grace to turn much deeper day by day.
When we touch our spirit—such a thrill!
This is far beyond emotion, mind, and will—
Come, make home in all our heart;
Let Your presence flow as rivers deep within.

title: O Morning Star!
first_line: O Morning Star! Arise ere day is broken,

lines: O Morning Star! Arise ere day is broken,
Shine, Thou, dear Lord—our hope, our light, our way;
Thou art that noble root and fruit of David,
Lucent above, guides to a perfect day.
O Morning Star! Arise in secret stillness,
Break through the gloom, the darkness of this age;
Burst forth, Thou Sun of Righteousness, in splendor!
Come now, our King, turn Thou a glorious page.
O Morning Star! Ascend before the dawning,
In twilight radiate—how clear and bright!
While here we love and wait for Thy dear coming,
O Morning Star! Spring forth from my heart’s fountain,
As we attend to Thy prophetic word;
Glow as a lamp amidst apostate darkness,
Until the morn arrives in all the earth.
O Morning Star! Appear to us Thy seekers!
Midst this black hour, we wait for Thy return.
Earnestly longing for Thy hidden presence;
Our fond Reward, for Thee we dearly yearn!

While here we love and wait for Thy dear coming,
Silently, Thou illuminate our night.

3

Glow as a lamp amidst apostate darkness,
Until the morn arrives in all the earth.

4

Midst this black hour, we wait for Thy return.
Earnestly longing for Thy hidden presence;
Our fond Reward, for Thee we dearly yearn!

title: This River
first_line: The Father God, the deepest spring,

lines: The Father God, the deepest spring,
The Spirit is the flowing spring,
The river of life, the triune spring,
This river is huge, this river is deep,
It’s flowing out from the smitten rock,
This river is clear, this river is pure,
The Triune God, the glorified Christ,
From Eden flows to every place,
By drinking of the stream of life,
This river of God is flowing free,
Wherever it flows conveys the tree,
This turbulent river is full and great,
These rapids of life will not relent
The Triune God mingling with men,
The sweetness of this river of life,

lyrics_text:
1
The Father God, the deepest spring,
The rich eternal source,
Emerges as the living spring,
In Jesus Christ, the course;
The Spirit is the flowing spring,
A springing up in us;
The river of life, the triune spring,
Profoundly glorious.

Chorus
This river is huge, this river is deep,
This river is wide,
It’s flowing out from the smitten rock,
The Savior’s side;
This river is clear, this river is pure,
This river is bright,
The Triune God, the glorified Christ,
Resurrection life.

2
Uniquely one, this flowing grace,
The living God divine
From Eden flows to every place,
And reaches all mankind;
By drinking of the stream of life,
The saints become His bride,
His counterpart, increase of Christ,
The issue from His side.

3
This river of God is flowing free,
A priceless living spring,
Wherever it flows conveys the tree,
Brings life to everything;
This turbulent river is full and great,
And man regenerates;
This hydropower permeates,
Transforms and saturates.

4
These rapids of life will not relent
But swiftly reach the end,
The Triune God mingling with men,
The New Jerusalem;
The sweetness of this river of life,
The all-inclusive Christ,
Will consummate the sanctified
Unto eternal life.

title: The Vision of God’s Building
first_line: Jacob saw the vision of a dream in Bethel,

lines: Jacob saw the vision of a dream in Bethel,
Moses saw the vision on a mountain, do tell,
David saw the vision of the holy temple,
Ezekiel saw the vision of the house.
Then John.... saw the vision of the New Jerusalem,
Well, it’s God.... dispensed and God built into men,
We need a vision so we open to the Lord,
Seeking revelation in the Holy Word,
Turning to the spirit for the building of the church,
The church is the fullness of the One.
Zechariah’s vision was for God’s recovery,
Daniel had a vision of Christ in victory,
Paul and Peter’s vision of the building of the Body
Complete the revelation of the age.

title: I need a new heart

lines: So God gave His Spirit to me,
Each morning, dear Lord, renew me;
Making home in all our hearts,
I need a new heart, today!
By loving the Lord more deeply;
And we all with unveiled face
From Your heart to mine, infuse me;
Showing love to all we meet,
Lord, give us Your heart, we pray!

matters of pride, defeat me;

title: I’m Not of This World Anymore
first_line: I’m not of this world anymore.

lines: I’m not of this world anymore.
To You, Lord, I am restored.
When I look into Your eyes,
With my hope now set on You,
There is nothing more to do.
Deep within my heart, O Lord, I’ll pray.
Perfect rest and peace of mind.
No more worry where to be,
For our lives are hidden, Lord, in Thee.
One new man then, Lord, we’ll be;
Christ in us the hope of glory.

lyrics_text:
1
I’m not of this world anymore.
To You, Lord, I am restored.
When I look into Your eyes,
My whole being’s fully satisfied.
With my hope now set on You,
There is nothing more to do.
Loving, living You this way,
Deep within my heart, O Lord, I’ll pray.

Refrain 1
Lord, I just love You,
Fill my heart, renew,
Be my life so true,
Manifesting You.

2

Perfect rest and peace of mind.
No more worry where to be,
For our lives are hidden, Lord, in Thee.
All opinions You’ll erase,
And this natural man abase.
One new man then, Lord, we’ll be;
Christ in us the hope of glory.

Refrain 2
Lord, we just love You,
Fill our hearts, renew,
As Your Body true,
Representing You.
